courses.subject: Physics
courses.title: The force you can't see
courses.hook: Rub a balloon on your head — why does your hair follow it up?
courses.lead: You can't touch it or see it, but it is definitely there. Find out what electricity actually is.

courses.subject: Physics
courses.title: Where will it land?
courses.hook: Why does a basketball arc? What changes when you change the angle?
courses.lead: Throw it, roll it, drop it — and find the one rule behind all of it.

courses.subject: Physics
courses.title: Wobbles and waves
courses.hook: Why does the timing of your push matter so much on a swing?
courses.lead: Start with a spring and end at sound and light. Everything that repeats is family.

courses.subject: Physics
courses.title: What light really is
courses.hook: Is light a particle or a wave? What if there isn't one answer?
courses.lead: From lenses to the experiment that turned physics upside down a century ago.

courses.subject: Chemistry
courses.title: Inside the atom
courses.hook: Split an atom and what falls out? And is it really mostly empty in there?
courses.lead: Build elements proton by proton, then watch a nucleus come apart.

courses.subject: Physics
courses.title: The strange quantum world
courses.hook: Nothing is decided until you look — what does that even mean?
courses.lead: Start with a coin toss and end where common sense breaks. No equations.

courses.subject: Earth science
courses.title: How the universe turns
courses.hook: Why doesn't the Moon fall into Earth? What if it is falling, constantly?
courses.lead: Place your own planets, build a solar system, and find where orbits break.

courses.subject: Chemistry
courses.title: Three faces of matter
courses.hook: Ice, water, steam — same thing or different things?
courses.lead: Turn up the heat, apply pressure, and learn to see individual molecules.

courses.subject: Chemistry
courses.title: What happens when you mix
courses.hook: Why does lemon juice fizz when it meets baking soda?
courses.lead: Measure pH, balance equations, and count what's left over.

courses.subject: Math
courses.title: A fraction is division
courses.hook: Three pizzas shared by four people — how much each?
courses.lead: Stop seeing a number over a number. Start seeing an amount.

courses.subject: Math
courses.title: A feel for ratios
courses.hook: Two packs of noodles take 1L of water. How much for three?
courses.lead: Ratio isn't arithmetic, it's a feel. We start by matching them by eye.

courses.subject: Math
courses.title: Speaking in graphs
courses.hook: What does a "steep" slope actually mean?
courses.lead: Move between equation and picture until changing a number moves the line in your head.

courses.subject: Biology
courses.title: Living things and the Earth
courses.hook: One island ends up all white rabbits, another all brown. What decided it?
courses.lead: From a population of rabbits to the inside of a cell to the whole planet — how balance is held, and what happens when it breaks.

courses.subject: Math
courses.title: Getting friendly with numbers
courses.hook: How much bigger is 7 than 3? What does "by 4" actually mean?
courses.lead: Count, compare, pair up. Every bit of math starts here.

force-unseen.title: Why a balloon pulls your hair
force-unseen.hook: Nothing happened before you rubbed it. What changed?

force-unseen.title: The invisible map around a charge
force-unseen.hook: Put down one charge and the space around it is already different?

force-unseen.title: Double the distance — what happens to the force?
force-unseen.hook: Half? Or a lot more than half?

force-unseen.title: Move a magnet, make electricity
force-unseen.hook: What if this one thing is all a power station does?

fraction.title: Three pizzas, four people
fraction.hook: What if the fraction bar is really a division sign?

fraction.title: Why multiplying works and adding doesn't
fraction.hook: You did the same thing to the top and the bottom — so why did the value change?

fraction.title: When the top is bigger than the bottom
fraction.hook: What if 8/3 isn't a mistake at all?

fraction.title: Many ways to build the same fraction
fraction.hook: What if there's more than one way to make one half?

fraction.title: Different face, same number
fraction.hook: Can you spot the same number hiding in a picture, a fraction and a mixed number?

atom.title: What decides which element it is
atom.hook: Add one neutron to hydrogen — does it become helium?

atom.title: An atom is mostly empty space
atom.hook: What if you fired a cannon at tissue paper and it bounced back?

atom.title: An electron can't just be anywhere
atom.hook: Why does an atom emit a few sharp lines instead of a rainbow?

atom.title: The moment a nucleus gives out
atom.hook: Neutrons don't change the element — so why does adding too many break it?

atom.title: Nobody knows when it will break
atom.hook: What if one is unknowable but a million are exactly predictable?

atom.title: The moment one element becomes another
atom.hook: There are no electrons in a nucleus — so where does the emitted one come from?

graph.title: Putting a number on "steep"
graph.hook: Can "that hill is steep" become a single number?

graph.title: Two numbers decide the line
graph.hook: In y = mx + b, what happens to the line if you change only b?

graph.title: Minus, yet it moves right
graph.hook: Why is the vertex of y = (x − 3)² at 3 and not at −3?

graph.title: Slope becomes a graph too
graph.hook: If the slope changes from place to place, what shape do those slopes make?

number.title: The many faces of seven
number.hook: What if the digit 7, seven objects and the word "seven" are all one thing?

number.title: How much bigger
number.hook: How do you get from "7 is bigger" to "bigger by 4"?

number.title: One number, two pieces
number.hook: How many ways can you split 10 into two pieces?

number.title: Distance has no direction
number.hook: How is "3 units apart" different from "moved −3"?

number.title: A balance scale is an equation
number.hook: If = doesn't mean "here comes the answer", what does it mean?

number.title: A box that changes what you put in
number.hook: Chain two boxes together — does the order matter?

number.title: Is a square a rectangle?
number.hook: Does a shape's name come from how it looks, or from what it satisfies?

number.title: An average is not enough
number.hook: Is a river with an average depth of 1 m safe?

ratio.title: Adding does not preserve a ratio
ratio.hook: Two packs of noodles take 3 cups of water — so four packs take 5 or 6?

ratio.title: Same ratio, same result
ratio.hook: Pour three times as much paint — does the colour get three times deeper?

ratio.title: Which one is actually cheaper
ratio.hook: Six for 3000 or ten for 4500 — which is the better deal?

ratio.title: A mean is a fair share
ratio.hook: Let the water level out — why is that height the average?

react.title: One pH step is ten times
react.hook: Lemon juice and coffee differ by 3 on the scale — how many times is that really?

react.title: Strong is not the same as concentrated
react.hook: Same amount in the beaker — so why is one of them stronger?

react.title: Only the number in front
react.hook: Why can't you fix the equation by turning H₂O into H₂O₂?

react.title: Whatever runs out first decides
react.hook: Ten slices of bread and three of cheese — how many sandwiches?

react.title: Measuring concentration by colour
react.hook: The solution didn't change — so why does a wider cuvette absorb more?

throw.title: Sideways doesn't slow the fall
throw.hook: Drop one ball, throw another sideways — which lands first?

throw.title: Same setup, different landing
throw.hook: Fire 100 shots without touching a dial — where do they land?

throw.title: You can't go higher than you started
throw.hook: Why is the first hill of a roller coaster always the tallest?

throw.title: When 3 plus 4 isn't 7
throw.hook: Add an arrow of length 3 to one of length 4 — how long is the result?

wave.title: Twice the stretch, four times the energy
wave.hook: The force doubles — so why does the energy quadruple?

wave.title: A bigger swing takes the same time
wave.hook: A wider swing travels farther — shouldn't it take longer?

wave.title: The wave moves, the rope doesn't
wave.hook: In a stadium wave, where does each person actually go?

wave.title: Every wave is a sum of sine waves
wave.hook: Can you build a square wave out of nothing but round sine waves?

space.title: The Moon is still falling
space.hook: Switch gravity off mid-orbit — where does the Moon go?

space.title: The Sun wobbles too
space.hook: How hard does the Earth pull on the Sun?

space.title: Closer means faster
space.hook: If the orbit isn't a circle, where does the planet move fastest?

life.title: The rabbit doesn't change, the population does
life.hook: On brown ground, does a white rabbit turn brown?

life.title: A cell membrane is picky
life.hook: What if something can't get in no matter how much of it is outside?

life.title: What comes in must go out
life.hook: Add greenhouse gas — does the planet just keep heating forever?

light.title: Cover half the lens — does half the image go?
light.hook: Put your hand over the bottom of a magnifying glass. What happens to the image?

light.title: Hot things change colour
light.hook: A blue star or a red star — which one is hotter?

light.title: Brighter doesn't always help
light.hook: Shine red light a hundred times brighter — do electrons come out?

light.title: One at a time, and still a pattern
light.hook: Fire particles one by one — why does a wave pattern build up?

matter.title: Ice and water are the same particles
matter.hook: Heat it up — do the particles get bigger, or faster?

matter.title: Pressure is particles hitting the wall
matter.hook: What exactly is it that inflates a balloon?

matter.title: Why water is bent
matter.hook: CO₂ is straight — so why isn't H₂O?

matter.title: Shape decides the properties
matter.hook: Can every bond be lopsided while the molecule is not?

quantum.title: A hidden coin is not a quantum coin
quantum.hook: How is "I don't know yet" different from "it isn't decided yet"?

quantum.title: Measuring changes it
quantum.hook: What if changing the order of measurements changed the answer?

quantum.title: Trap it and the energy becomes steps
quantum.hook: Why can an electron only sit on certain rungs?
